2115850175868727621.text:
Day 25/

We are doubling all usage limits for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium, effective today.

We heard your kind feedback and won't be reducing usage limits for Pro 200, so your Work and Codex usage will stay the same. We're also going to continue offering extended limits for dots for now, and usage of your dot will still continue to be separate from your default usage.

And we'll of course also keep shipping better models and other efficiency improvements that increase your effective usage over time.
2115850175868727621.translation: 第 25 天/我们今天起将所有 Pro 100/200/500 档位与 Business Premium 的用量限额全部翻倍。我们听到了大家的善意反馈,不会下调 Pro 200 的用量限额,你的 Work 与 Codex 用量将保持不变。我们也将暂时继续为 dots 提供扩展限额,你的 dot 用量仍与默认用量分开计算。当然,我们还会持续发布更好的模型与其他效率改进,随时间提升你的有效用量。

2113770862860222611.text:
On codex cli updates. We've added reusable prompt presets, inline model and permission settings, and enterprise MCP sign-in. We've also fixed failures when resuming long sessions and added Windows corporate-proxy authentication.

Surprisingly the CLI has grown 2X in usage since devday.
2113770862860222611.translation: 关于 codex cli 更新:新增可复用提示词预设、内联模型与权限设置、企业版 MCP 登录;修复了恢复长会话时的失败,并加入 Windows 企业代理认证。意外的是,自 devday 以来 CLI 用量翻倍。

2113770573994299544.text: Day 19/ Small updates. Calls connect much faster for dots, changing reasoning in codex & work mid conversation does not invalidate cache anymore and a we've also updated the codex cli.

2112712984644784534.text: Day 16/  You can now cache for 12h in the API and for logged in users across Codex & Work we keep cache forever and you don't have any penalty for coming back to an old conversation or resuming after a few hours and are now guaranteed to hit the cache.
2112712984644784534.translation: Day 16/ API 现在可以缓存 12 小时;对于 Codex 与 Work 的登录用户,我们永久保留缓存——回到旧对话或数小时后恢复会话不再有任何惩罚,并保证能够命中缓存。

2112592264686149749.text: There were reports of usage draining faster than anticipated for some users over the weekend. We've identified approximately 40,000 accounts that had an inconsistency on which usage limits where the actual usage that was applied did not correspond to their actual selected plan. We are reaching out individually to all these users and have corrected the issue. If this affected you, we'll add credits to your account. Sorry we got this wrong.
2112592264686149749.translation: 有用户报告周末期间额度消耗快于预期。我们确认了约 40,000 个账户存在用量上限不一致的问题:实际扣减的用量与所选套餐不符。我们已逐一联系全部受影响用户并修正了该问题。如果你受到影响,我们会向你的账户添加补偿额度。抱歉我们出了这个错。

2112432076767289678.text: Day 15 of the 28-day ship-or-reset series: hours after “We’re cooked”, Tibo posted the global reset: “Nevermind, we’re still cooking... and reset. Enjoy.”

2112034063934742720.text:
Our team worked with OpenCode to have their users who are also OpenAI API customers back in business and any credits refunded which would have been drawn in the attack.

Also, you can request Daybreak Blue access to use our cyber permissive setup for defense. Do not wait until you have to deal with an incident. We’re here to help.
2112034063934742720.translation:
我们的团队与 OpenCode 合作,让那些同时也是 OpenAI API 客户的用户恢复了业务,并在攻击中本会被消耗的额度已获退款。

另外,你可以申请 Daybreak Blue 访问权限,使用我们的网络宽松防御环境。不要等到事发才来处理。我们随时提供帮助。

2111990254408434095.text:
Day 14/

Small quality of life improvement. You can now edit previous messages within a thread in the desktop app. Long time requested, and took way too long to get that one out.
2111990254408434095.translation: 第14天／小幅体验改进：现在可以在桌面应用中编辑聊天里的历史消息。这是大家期待已久的功能，推出得太晚了。

2111492738025959922.text: Day 13 of the 28-day ship-or-reset series: the global reset promised “by EOD PST” landed at 20:41 UTC on our checks; Tibo then posted: “Done.”

2111492673890824348.translation: 第 13 天/ 就是额度重置(法语梗:Le limit reset)

2111244596131111253.text:
Day 12/

We’ve made improvements to Codex & Work that increase the effective usage you get. We achieved this by reusing context across subagents, keeping context cached longer, and improved request routing that allows us to increase cache hits.
2111244596131111253.translation:
第 12 天/

我们对 Codex 和 Work 做了多项改进,提升你能获得的实际有效用量。实现方式包括:跨子代理复用上下文、延长上下文缓存时间,以及改进请求路由以提高缓存命中率。

2110951585983631505.text: @maria_rcks Can’t argue with that, Let’s break the cycle.
2110951585983631505.translation: @maria_rcks 没法反驳,咱们打破这个循环吧。

2110750421367287996.text:
Day 11/

We've landed a series of changes and more compute to very significantly decrease the occurrence of the disruptive "Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model". When it does happen, it should also eventually just continue by itself and not just block on it.

Let us know if you still see it out there in the wild and we'll take a look.
2110750421367287996.translation:
第 11 天/

我们已经上线了一系列变更并增加了算力,以非常显著地减少那个扰人的「所选模型已达容量上限,请尝试其他模型」提示的出现。即使真的出现,它最终也应自动继续执行,而不是卡在那里。

如果大家在实际使用中仍然遇到它,请告诉我们,我们会跟进处理。

We have increased default context length for GPT-6.1 Sol to 500k when used through Codex & Work, up from 272k or an ~ 80% increase.

(a) We didn't want to compromise in other ways and are committing to not reintroducing the 5h limit, so that you can fully use the weekly usage when you want. (b) On the subscription, we guarantee that over time you always get more work done and with an increasing level of quality. (c) We don't want to put an incentive on ourselves to artificially inflate the API list prices to make it look like you are getting a lot (and workaround it through discounts, etc).
